question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE consumption > 528.3) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_customers_above_threshold
FROM yearmonth
WHERE date = '201202';
